title: On macOS with Python 3.15, test_idle and test_tkinter fail with `_tkinter.TclError: invalid command name "::tk::unsupported::MacWindowStyle"` on Tk/Tcl 9.1
author: vstinner
body_preview: Tcl/Tk was recently upgraded from Tcl 9.0/Tk 9.0 to Tcl 9.1/Tk 9.1 on macOS GitHub Action. title: _testcapi._tuple_resize() leaks item references on allocation failure
author: lagergren-oai
body_preview: ### Bug report  `_PyTuple_Resize()` leaks references to the tuple's elements when the underlying `PyObject_GC_Resize()` fails. It sets the caller's pointer to NULL and frees the old tuple storage with `PyObject_GC_Del()`, but does not release the references held in that storage.  The old allocation remains valid after the failed resize, so its remaining elements must be decref'ed before it is free...
